source.public_versification_note: Public Deuteronomy 22:30 binds Hebrew 23:1; public 23:1–25 binds Hebrew 23:2–26. All other verses in chapters 19–26 align directly. All 179 original XML records, including written/read and numbering notes, are hashed in full.

key_decisions.decision: Keeps corporal punishment, posture, supervision, and proportional counting without softening the physical act.
Retains forty rather than the later thirty-nine practice, and degradation of one's fellow as the limit's stated reason.
Keeps co-resident brothers, no son, outside-marriage ban, and the brother-in-law's sexual/marital duty; child alternative is noted.
Retains her actions, the literal face-spitting reading, and the house-building kinship image.
Retains her protective motive and the explicitly sexual body part without hiding the stipulated action.
Preserves the plain hand-amputation command and no-pity clause without replacing it with compensation.
Keeps the attack on the vulnerable rear and both fatigue terms; assigns the unmarked no-fear clause to Amalek, with alternative noted.
Preserves promised rest, total erasure language, and the deliberate remember/do-not-forget frame.
